title: Evaluating LLMs for Career Guidance: Comparative Analysis of Computing Competency Recommendations Across Ten African Countries

bias_targets.methodology: Directed content analysis of LLM-generated career guidance using standardized prompts across ten African countries, scoring responses on contextual awareness (references to local tech industries, cultural factors, national policies, and local institutions) versus Western-centric assumptions.

Qualitative evaluation of LLM recommendations to identify infrastructure bias, specifically tracking whether models presume universal access to high-resource technological infrastructure (e.g., Western cloud platforms) while ignoring local resource constraints.

Analyzing model outputs to detect linguistic homogenization, evaluating whether LLMs recognize local multilingual career requirements (e.g., Arabic, French, indigenous languages) or default to English-only assumptions.
